description: Match a physical address against listed addresses. Useful for KYC / supplier vetting when the counterparty's name is generic but the address is distinctive.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults vary per tool.

sources.description: Restrict screening to a subset of source lists. Defaults to all four. Allowed: OFAC_SDN, EU_CFSP, UN_SC, BIS_DPL.

threshold.description: Minimum confidence score (0..1) for a result to be returned. Defaults to 0.85.

name: sanctions_screen_address
